import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def solve():
    p, k = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    ans = 1
    if k == 0:
        i = 1
        while i < p:
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
            i += 1
    elif k == 1:
        i = 1
        while i <= p:
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
            i += 1
    else:
        vis = [0] * p
        for i in range(p):
            if not vis[i]:
                cur = i
                while True:
                    vis[cur] = 1
                    cur = (cur * k) % p
                    if vis[cur]:
                        break
                if cur != 0:
                    ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    return ans

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(solve())
